name: Package Addition
about: Suggest a new package to add to Nixite
title: '[PACKAGE] Add <package-name>'
labels: 'type:package-request, priority:medium'
assignees: ''
---

## Package Information

**Package Name:**
<!-- Official display name (e.g., Firefox, Visual Studio Code) -->

**Package ID:**
<!-- Exact nixpkgs package name (verify with: nix search nixpkgs <name>) -->

**Homepage:**
<!-- Official website URL -->

**License:**
<!-- Package license (e.g., MIT, GPL-3.0, Apache-2.0) -->

## Package Details

**Category:**
<!-- Select ONE category that best fits:
- Create (Content Creation & Media)
- Connect (Communication & Collaboration)
- Grow (Learning & Development)
- Work (Productivity & Business)
- Play (Gaming & Entertainment)
- Secure (Security & Privacy)
- Manage (System Administration)
- Serve (Server & Infrastructure)
-->

**Description:**
<!-- Clear 5-15 word description of what users can DO with this package.
Focus on benefits and actions, not technical details.

Good examples:
- "Edit photos and create graphics"
- "Browse the web privately and securely"
- "Write code with intelligent completion"

Bad examples:
- "A web browser" (too vague)
- "Advanced image manipulation program" (too technical)
-->

**Tags:**
<!-- 2-5 relevant tags (lowercase, comma-separated)
Examples: web, browser, privacy, editor, graphics, photo
-->

## Why Should This Package Be Added?

**Popularity:**
<!-- Is it widely used? Mention user base or GitHub stars if known -->

**Usefulness:**
<!-- What need does it fill? Who would benefit from it? -->

**Quality:**
<!-- Is it well-maintained? Recent updates? Good documentation? -->

## Verification Checklist

Please verify the following before submitting:

- [ ] Package exists in nixpkgs (verified with `nix search nixpkgs <name>`)
- [ ] Package is actively maintained (updated within last year)
- [ ] Package works on NixOS without major issues
- [ ] Description is clear and beginner-friendly (5-15 words)
- [ ] Category selection is appropriate
- [ ] Tags are relevant and lowercase
- [ ] No duplicate package request exists

## Additional Information

**Screenshots (optional):**
<!-- Add screenshots or links to help reviewers understand the package -->

**Similar Packages:**
<!-- Are there similar packages already in Nixite? How is this different? -->

**Notes:**
<!-- Any other relevant information -->
